newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Q1 capital spending rose 6.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Q1 capital spending rose 6.5 pct.

text.p: Australian private new capital expenditure rose 6.5 percent, seasonally-adjusted, in the March quarter to an estimated A$11.00 billion from A$10.33 billion in the December quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with A$9.28 billion a year earlier. Figures are at average 1989/90 prices.

The sixth estimate for capex in 1996/97 is A$43.81 billion, compared with the fifth estimate of A$42.86 billion. The second estimate for 1997/98 was A$36.57 billion, compared with the first estimate of A$31.90 billion, which was revised from A$34.68 billion reported last quarter.
Actual private new capital expenditure (in billion A$, seasonally adjusted constant prices):
INDUSTRY March qtr 97 Dec qtr 96 March qtr 96
The market had expected March quarter CAPEX to rise around 3.5 percent.
The sixth estimate for 1996/97 capex was 12.2 percent above the corresponding estimate for 1995/96.
The second estimate for 1997/98 of A$36.57 billion was 1.5 percent higher than the corresponding second estimate for 1996/97.
